result.title: One Subspace Is Not Enough: LocalSubspaceAD for Training-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
result.summary: Defect-free industrial samples can vary considerably in appearance, texture, and geometry. In few-shot anomaly detection, this variability has to be modeled from only a handful of images. SubspaceAD showed that a single principal subspace of foundation-model patch features is a strong training-free model of nominal appearance. However, a single subspace has to cover all of the nominal data's variability, so a deviation that is anomalous for one semantic region can be within the nominal variability of another. We propose LocalSubspaceAD, which extends SubspaceAD from a single subspace to a mixture of subspaces, assigning each group of patches with similar features its own subspace. The set of patch-features is partitioned using k-means, one subspace is fit per cluster, and each patch is scored by the minimum of re-projection residuals over all subspaces. The proposed method requires no training and no EM refinement. On MVTec AD, VisA and Real-IAD with 1, 2 and 4 shots, it improves over a single subspace (SubspaceAD) on both evaluated backbones: by 1.2 to 1.8 points image AUROC on DINOv2, and by 1.4 to 4.4 points in image AUROC, pixel AUPR and AUPRO on DINOv3. The gains are most pronounced on objects with heterogeneous nominal appearance, such as multi-instance categories and PCBs. Ablations show that the gains stem from a finer-grained model of variability through locally oriented subspaces, rather than from the subspace offsets (cluster means). We further show that the gains do not stem from added capacity alone: the local subspaces appear to capture the structure of coherent clusters in feature space, and the model does not merely act as a compressed memory bank.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LocalSubspaceAD，在无训练的少样本工业异常检测中，把 SubspaceAD 的单一主成分子空间扩展为子空间混合：用 k-means 对 patch 特征分区、逐簇拟合子空间，再以所有子空间上的最小重投影残差为每个 patch 打分，并在 MVTec AD、VisA、Real-IAD 上验证优于单子空间。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按局部语义聚类并逐簇建模特征流形、以最小残差判定的思路，可能可供核查能否作为探测 VLM 内部视觉特征是否保留局部细节与区域异质性的诊断手段；但研究对象是工业缺陷检测，与 LVR 的推理生成流程无直接联系。
